Priya Singh: Hello all  excited to join Product today. Quick heads-up: my laptop arrived but I need help installing docker and the code signing cert. Anyone available for a quick handoff? :wave:
Riley Martin: welcome Priya! :tada: ping @Dev-Helpdesk for installs and certs. Also check the dev-bootstrap doc in Confluence.
Priya Singh: thanks Riley. I'm blocked on the cert step  the installer errors with 'certificate not trusted'.
Dev-Helpdesk: @Priya can you attach the installer log? Also try opening the cert file in Keychain and setting it to always trust for codesigning. If it's still failing, we'll create a temporary dev cert for you.
Priya Singh: setting trust in Keychain fixed it. Docker installed and code signing verified. Where's the quick intro sync?
Tara Gomez: hey Priya  we'll do a 15-minute intro in #product at 2pm PT. Bring your two truths & a lie! :grin:
Priya Singh: will do! Fun fact: I'm a weekend barista and once entered a latte art contest.
Riley Martin: nice! welcome aboard :party-parrot:
ops-bot: Onboarding checklist updated: laptop (done), docker (done), cert (done).
